method: Direct normalized full given/family-name lookup in the rebuilt original-row union. Selected-IVIS precinct rows are aggregated by municipality code, district, ballot and full name; nationwide winner rows are retained individually outside normalized municipality/name pairs already covered by selected-IVIS. National duplicates are not inferred away from claim IDs or accepted/held totals. The quoted multiline header is parsed as one CSV record before choosing semicolon. Logical CSV row numbers are distinct from physical lines. No identity or outcome approval is implied by a name match.
normalization: Unicode NFKD; ASCII diacritic folding; lower case; keep only a-z and 0-9, identical to research.norm.
limitations: The national original is winner-only. Missing losing, withdrawn and substitute rosters are not repaired by these counts.
Exact-name matches include namesakes and remain separate from approved identity joins.
Frozen proposal, accepted roster, journal and delta002 bytes remain unchanged.
